use_case_summary: Sable Orbit runs a multitenant routing and chat assistant for freight operators. Primary workloads: chat assistant (low-latency conversational), embeddings for route similarity and full-text search, and reranking for candidate deliveries. Target p50 latency < 180ms for chat; throughput peaks 3k-5k qps during business hours. High cost sensitivity on token spend; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching + quant profiles). Requires EU data residency for customers in EU and VPC network isolation for enterprise accounts.
notes:
Account background: long-time hosted API customer (since 2022) on tiered monthly plan. They've incrementally added endpoints; now hitting performance ceilings during peak routing windows. 
- Customer quote: "We need predictable SLAs — when routing blows up our queues back up and partners notice delays." 
- Sales angle: cross-sell Dedicated for baseline throughput + Optimize to reduce unit costs; Private/VPC for regulated European customers. 
- Security asks: signed ISO27001 evidence (done), want KMS integration diagram (we provided), audit log retention policy (30/90 day options requested). 
- Technical notes: observed cache-hit rate low on embeddings; SE recommends prefix caching + increased KV cache memory on dedicated pool. Marcus proposed a mixed routing policy (latency-first for EU, cost-first for NA) to control spend. 
- Commercial: procurement prefers annual commit with quarterly true-up. CFO requested FY2025 blended ARR before final. Price sensitivity around GPU availability in eu-west-1 — they want guaranteed node placement or fallback pricing tiers. 
- Quick wins: apply Optimize batching rules (pilot reduced token spend ~18% in week 1), schedule dedicated pool sizing workshop (Marcus).
- Risk: if we miss EU residency compliance timeline, they will evaluate Major Cloud AI and internal on-prem prototype.
